FEDERAL ROADS (PRIVATE MANAGEMENT) ACT 1984

FEDERAL ROADS (PRIVATE MANAGEMENT) (COLLECTION OF TOLLS)

(KUALA LUMPUR−PUTRAJAYA HIGHWAY) (AMENDMENT) ORDER 2015

IN exercise of the powers conferred by section 2 of the Federal Roads (Private

Management) Act 1984 [Act 306], the Minister makes the following order:

Citation and commencement

1. (1) This order may be cited as the Federal Roads (Private Management)

(Collection of Tolls) (Kuala Lumpur−Putrajaya Highway) (Amendment) Order

 (2) This Order comes into operation on 15 October 2015.

General amendment

2. The Federal Roads (Private Management) (Collection of Tolls)

(Kuala Lumpur−Putrajaya Highway) Order 2008 [P.U. (A) 15/2008], which is referred to

as "principal Order" in this Order, is amended by substituting for the words

"Kuala Lumpur−Putrajaya" the words "Maju Expressway" wherever appearing.

Substituting of First Schedule

3. The principal Order is amended by substituting for the First Schedule the

following Schedule:

"FIRST SCHEDULE

[subparagraph 2(1)]

(1)

(2)

wheels (excluding bus)

4.00 7.00

3. Vehicle having three axles or more

(excluding bus)

6.00 10.50

4. Taxi 1.00 1.80

5. Bus 1.50 2.50

For the purpose of calculating the number of axles and wheels of a vehicle, the axles and

wheels of any trailer towed by the vehicle shall be calculated as part of the axles and

wheels of the vehicle.".

Made 12 October 2015

[KKR.PUU.110/1/7 /19;PN(PU2)426/LX]

DATO' SRI HAJI FADILLAH BIN HAJI YUSOF
